args.description: List of CLI arguments to pass to gpgv. Each item must be a single argument (e.g., '--keyring /path/to/keyring', '-v'). Order preserved; no implicit quoting applied. Valid options correspond to documented gpgv(1) flags: --verbose/-v, --quiet/-q, --keyring, --output, --status-fd, --logger-fd, --log-file, --ignore-time-conflict, --homedir, --weak-digest, --enable-special-filenames, --assert-pubkey-algo. Filenames with tilde (~) will be expanded by gpgv itself when resolved relative to home directory. Use empty list to omit all options (default behavior).
